overview_description.description:
Kisan Network is a tech-enabled supply chain startup focused on agriculture. It is an enabled and fully integrated PAN India Agri produce supply chain connecting marginal farmers directly to businesses.

The company started in 2016 and is headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana, India.
